title: The Aurelia Round Brilliant
description: A masterfully cut round brilliant diamond with exceptional fire and scintillation. Its D color grade places it among the rarest and most colorless stones in existence, while VVS1 clarity ensures a face-up appearance that is virtually flawless to the naked eye.

title: The Meridian Oval
description: An elegant elongated oval cut that maximizes carat weight while flattering the hand. Excellent brilliance across the pavilion with a bright, even light return and no visible bow-tie effect.

title: The Belmore Emerald Cut
description: A step-cut emerald diamond prized for its hall-of-mirrors clarity and understated, architectural elegance. The open table showcases exceptional transparency and a cool, icy brilliance.

title: The Rosalind Cushion
description: A showstopping cushion-cut diamond combining a soft, romantic silhouette with dramatic scale. Superior light performance and a near-colorless grade make this a rare statement stone.

title: The Hartley Pear
description: A graceful pear-shaped diamond with a well-defined point and rounded end, ideal for a pendant or as an elegant complement to a two-stone design. Bright and lively face-up appearance.
